proposition: The Mabdaʾ u Maʿād was written at the request of one Shāh Rażī l-Dīn, as its introduction states, and was completed early Ṣafar 832/mid-November 1428 at Manzil-i Chālū in Mazandaran, the same date and place as its Majlis 10196 copy.

mediation.who: Ibn Turka's introduction and the Majlis 10196 colophon
mediation.note: date and place of the completion equal those of the copy
